card.name: Conditional words before a required action
card.fires_on: Small conditional words such as "is", "if", "unless" and "use" in clauses like "if co-medication is considered necessary". They come just before the instruction that follows the condition.

modes.label: If X is necessary
modes.description: The verb or noun in an if-clause about needing a combination or co-medication, before the monitoring instruction.
modes.example: If co-medication<< is>> considered necessary, monitoring of serum potassium is

modes.label: Unless or if as an exception
modes.description: The words "unless" or "if" introduce an exception to a stated rule or timing.
modes.example: at least 2 weeks prior to the first dose of PIASKY,<< unless>> the risks of delaying therapy with PIASK

card.writes: It slightly promotes words like "missing" and suppresses "rules" and "preferences", with no clear tie to this pattern.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that opens an exception or condition, such as "if" or "unless", just before the instruction that follows.
